maccabean.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Judas Maccabeus or to the Maccabees;
   as, the Maccabean princes; Maccabean times.
maccabean.translation: a. (犹太游击队领导人) 马加比的, 马加比家族的( 亦作Maccabaean)

maccabees.definition:
n. pl. The name given later times to the Asmonaeans, a
   family of Jewish patriots, who headed a religious revolt in the reign
   of Antiochus IV., 168-161 B. C., which led to a period of freedom for
   Israel.
n. pl. The name of two ancient historical books, which give
   accounts of Jewish affairs in or about the time of the Maccabean
   princes, and which are received as canonical books in the Roman
   Catholic Church, but are included in the Apocrypha by Protestants. Also
   applied to three books, two of which are found in some MSS. of the
   Septuagint.
